title: SDLC intake: choose the next useful action
scenario: Use an installed SDLC skill with a request, issue or PR and an explicit endpoint. These screenshots show exact excerpts from synthetic native Sonnet 5.5 runs on 2026-10-18; they are browser-rendered transcript excerpts, not terminal screenshots. Full verification and limits are in docs/verification/sdlc-intake.md.

steps.title: Clarify only the decisions that block progress
steps.instruction: Ask: Use sdlc to handle this issue; prepare what is needed next. Provide the issue or URL and the desired endpoint. The agent inspects available facts and identifies consequential unanswered decisions before dependent implementation.
steps.caption: Actual vague-request response excerpt. No implementation was made in this run.
steps.expected: You receive the next question or bounded investigation with evidence, rather than invented product behavior.

steps.title: Continue from adequate work and inspect evidence
steps.instruction: For a settled spec and plan, ask sdlc to implement locally or finish at your chosen PR endpoint. Check actual changed files and executed verification. Review-only requests keep their endpoint; resumption reuses valid work.
steps.caption: Actual ready-task response excerpt from a fresh-context repeat. The original run had a scratch-path violation; that failure remains in the verification record.
steps.expected: Valid artifacts are reused and real checks support the result. Local fixture results do not establish live tracker synchronization or universal model reliability.
